notes: Moves the AssertJ assertion chain on the results map onto a SoftAssertions object that is never followed by assertAll, so its failures are collected and never reported. Rejected with weaken_assertion/soft_assertions_unchecked. Built on the pre image of reject-junit4-assume-environment-precondition: the line assertThat(results) becomes a declaration of a fully qualified org.assertj.core.api.SoftAssertions named softly, followed by softly.assertThat(results); the rest of the chain is unchanged.
